name: Raoa Addons for Elementor
author: raoatech

sections.description:
Raoa Addons for Elementor is a smart, lightweight, and performance‑optimized addon pack for Elementor—offering 5 free widgets crafted to strengthen and speed up your design workflow.

Available Widgets

  • Menu – Build flexible navigation layouts with full Elementor control
  • Split Tabs – Organize content using clean, interactive tab sections
  • Post Grid – Display posts in responsive, customizable grid layouts
  • Year Counter – Automatically display dynamic year values
  • Text Slider – Create lightweight animated text effects

Features

  • Lightweight & fast performance
  • Clean and maintainable code structure
  • Fully responsive widgets
  • Elementor-friendly controls
  • Developer-friendly architecture
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ raoa-addons-for-elementor directory, or install via WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Open Elementor and use the widgets.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated.

Will this plugin affect site speed?

No. The plugin is designed with performance as a priority.
